handoff.summary: Frame, resize, rotation, Gallery binding, and thumbnail ordering now use immutable image/frame identity and world-space crop geometry. The focused regression batch passes 33/33, the unit/integration suite passes 190/190, and the production build passes.

ownership.rule: ProjectManager view id is immutable and owns image state.
Frame state is keyed by imageId::tab:tabId.
View rotation is applied to Fabric background/objects. CanvasManager.rotateViewport is false, therefore viewport geometry functions must receive rotation 0.
orderedImageLabels owns display order only; it never renames a view.
measurementGuideModelLinksByScope owns frame bindings and measurementGuideModelLinksByImage owns image fallbacks.

pipeline.name: tab-or-image-switch
pipeline.step: Save outgoing Fabric objects and exact viewport.
Preserve the outgoing authored frame worldRect; navigation never recalculates it.
Switch immutable image id and load that image's canvas data.
Restore Fabric object/background rotation.
Restore the active frame's worldRect.
Derive the DOM frame and viewport once from the worldRect.
Apply visibility for only the active image/frame scope.

pipeline.name: window-or-monitor-resize
pipeline.step: Resize the Fabric backing canvas.
Resolve the responsive DOM frame from stored relative frame dimensions.
Keep the frame's authored worldRect unchanged.
Fit that exact worldRect into the newly sized DOM frame.
Write zoom and pan together; never resize the frame independently of the viewport.
Persist updated screen dimensions without rewriting the crop.

pipeline.name: legacy-geometry-migration
pipeline.step: Load saved backgroundWorldRect as the authoritative full-image bounds.
Load frame worldRect as the preferred crop.
If an old frame worldRect exceeds the saved image bounds by more than 5%, classify it as CSS-scaled-coordinate corruption and recover from backgroundWorldRect.
Do not use overlap heuristics; valid rotated crops can have low AABB overlap.

pipeline.name: gallery-import-and-binding
pipeline.step: Create one immutable guide image id from code and variant.
Register through ImageRegistry, which updates ProjectManager, Gallery, and sidebar.
Persist guide label, selection id, and image binding before temporary canvas switches.
Import SVG/MOS/measurement objects only inside the new image/frame scope.
Restore the previous active image when requested.
Serialize and reload the same image ids and scope links.

pipeline.name: thumbnail-reorder
pipeline.step: Drag source and target communicate immutable image labels, never captured indices.
Move the matching Gallery data entry.
Rebuild modern cards with current indices and stable card/caption structure.
Reorder visible sidebar nodes to the same label order.
Update orderedImageLabels and mini-stepper.
Keep currentViewId and every image/frame binding unchanged.
